c35.descriptionHtml:
These are the pieces that keep getting reordered: the 10x10 tents, the stretch table covers, the feather flags, the SEG walls that make a booth look finished. Twenty years of event seasons taught us what survives real weekends, and this page is that list. Everything here is custom-printed with your brand in LA and delivered nationwide in 5 business days after proof approval.

Starting from scratch? Get a free proof on any $500+ order and see your brand on the gear before you commit.

seo.description: The event displays customers reorder most: canopy tents, table covers, flags, and SEG backdrops. Printed in LA. 5 business days from proof approval.

c36.descriptionHtml:
Your tent is the first thing people see from across the lot, so make it earn the walk over. We print 10x10, 10x15, and 10x20 canopy tents with your brand on every panel: canopy, valance, walls, even matching tent banners. Every panel is printed in LA by a team that's been building event displays for more than 20 years. Tents start at $800, and once you approve your proof and pay, yours ships anywhere in the country within 5 business days.

Not sure how your logo will look up there? Send it over and we'll mock it up free before anything prints.

seo.description: Custom 10x10, 10x15, and 10x20 canopy tents with your brand, from $800. Free proof on $500+ orders. Printed in LA. 5 business days from proof approval.

c37.descriptionHtml:
A wrinkled backdrop reads cheap on camera. SEG tension-fabric displays don't wrinkle — the print stretches into an aluminum frame with a silicone edge, so the wall sits tight and your colors land exactly where you approved them. We print popup, pillowcase, and backlit versions starting at $248, all printed in LA and delivered nationwide in 5 business days after proof approval.

Orders of $500 or more come with a free proof, so send us your logo and see your wall before anything prints.

seo.description: SEG tension-fabric backdrops from $248 in backlit, popup, and pillowcase styles. Printed in LA. 5 business days from proof approval.
seo.title: SEG Backdrop Displays | Printed in LA — Promo & Grow

c38.descriptionHtml:
The same shop that prints your booth can print your walls. Canvas floating frames, SEG stretch frames, and standoff acrylic pieces start at $98 — your photos and campaigns, printed in LA with the same care we put into trade-show work, then delivered nationwide in 5 business days from proof approval. It's an easy way to make an office, lobby, or storefront feel finished.

Outfitting a whole space? Orders of $500 and up include a free proof of every piece before we print.

seo.description: Canvas floating frames, SEG stretch frames, and standoff acrylic prints from $98. Printed in LA. 5 business days from proof approval.

c39.descriptionHtml:
Flags do the waving so you don't have to. We print feather flags in angled and convex cuts, teardrops, rectangles, and the 16-ft econo, all starting at $120 with your brand in full color. They pack down small, set up in minutes, and hold up to real outdoor weekends, because we've been printing them in LA for 20+ years.

Building a bigger setup? On orders of $500 and up, the proof is free: send your logo and see the whole thing before you pay.

seo.description: Feather, teardrop, and rectangle flags custom-printed from $120. Real prices, no surprises. Printed in LA. 5 business days from proof approval.

c40.descriptionHtml:
A bare folding table says nobody's home. A fitted throw with your logo across the front says you came to work. We print draped covers for 4, 6, and 8-ft tables starting at $88, plus round, stretch, and runner styles — each one printed in LA and delivered nationwide in 5 business days after you approve the art.

Pairing it with a tent or backdrop? Orders of $500 and up include a free proof, so you can see your logo on everything before it prints.

seo.description: Custom table throws from $88 in draped, stretch, round, and runner styles for 4, 6, and 8 ft tables. Printed in LA. 5 business days from proof approval.
seo.title: Custom Table Throws | From $88, Printed in LA — Promo & Grow

c41.descriptionHtml:
Already own the hardware? Wrap it. We print full-color vinyl wraps for A-frame signs and event backdrops, so the frames you already haul around start working like the brand you are. Every wrap is printed in LA, cut to your frame's measurements, and delivered nationwide in 5 business days once the art is approved.

Not sure your file will hold up at full size? Send it over and we'll proof it at scale before anything prints — free on orders of $500 and up.

seo.description: A-frame wraps and event backdrop vinyl wraps, made to fit your frames. Printed in LA. 5 business days from proof approval.

c42.descriptionHtml:
One order, one proof, one delivery — and your whole booth shows up matching. Our bundles pair a custom tent with table covers, flags, and backdrops built in the same shop from the same art file, so nothing clashes on event day. Use the builder to pick your pieces: bundles start at $848, and adding a second piece earns 15% off the set. Everything is printed in LA and delivered nationwide in 5 business days once you approve the proof.

Start with the free part. Send us your logo and we'll proof the whole bundle before you pay a dime.

seo.description: Complete booth setups: tent, table cover, flags, and backdrop in one matching order. Printed in LA. 5 business days from proof approval.

c43.descriptionHtml:
Sometimes you just need the message up, big and clean. Our banners are printed full color and built for sun, wind, and load-in day. Our tent banners are cut to fit the canopies we build, so the whole booth reads like one brand instead of a parts bin. Everything is printed in LA by a crew that's been doing this for more than 20 years, and delivered anywhere in the country in 5 business days from proof approval.

Ordering banners as part of a bigger setup? On $500+ orders the proof is free — see it before you pay for it.

seo.description: Custom tent banners cut to fit the canopies we build, printed full color from 4ft. Printed in LA. 5 business days from proof approval.
seo.title: Custom Tent Banners | Printed in LA — Promo & Grow

c44.descriptionHtml: Retractable, X-frame, and tension-fabric banner stand hardware for booths, storefronts, and registration tables. Every stand ships with a full-color dye-sublimated graphic sized to fit, printed in LA and delivered anywhere in 5 business days from proof approval.

c45.descriptionHtml: Sidewalk A-frames, snap-open poster frames, floor stands, and magnetic hangers for storefront and indoor signage. Genuine Signicade hardware and easy-change insert options included. Printed in LA, delivered anywhere in 5 business days from proof approval.

c46.descriptionHtml: Yard signs, A-frames, posts, and rider frames for real estate agents and any small business that needs a message in the ground — open houses, curb promos, wayfinding, pop-up sales. Printed in LA, delivered anywhere in 5 business days from proof approval.
